task.description: Decide whether an outgoing museum loan is ready to ship. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_security, resolve_environment, resolve_light, resolve_offgassing, resolve_insurance, resolve_handling, or ready.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content: Outgoing-loan shipment review for Zara Adeyemi; readiness decision pending.

timeline.author: Destiny Nakamura
timeline.content:
- Given that Zara Adeyemi's upcoming performance review is expected to focus heavily on the security budget they championed, Zara Adeyemi has been returning repeatedly to this part of the review, and the facility provides 24-hour physical security.
- Two galleries in our district were broken into last month and the local coverage has made the trustees nervous, so they want me to press Zara Adeyemi's institution for an additional security review regardless of what the venue survey eventually shows.
- Destiny Nakamura's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Rafael Patel
timeline.content:
- Three months of readings remain near 68°F and 45% RH.
- The HVAC service firm bidding for renewal at Zara Adeyemi's institution has offered a free diagnostic visit if this loan is returned for an environmental follow-up, and I would rather use the opportunity than let the offer lapse.
- Rafael Patel has started taking evening classes toward a career change.
- Rafael Patel's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Mei Costa
timeline.content:
- Because a harsh critique early in Zara Adeyemi's career made them a perfectionist about how their lighting work is discussed, Zara Adeyemi has been pressing for attention to this issue, even as maximum measured light is 15 footcandles with no direct natural light.
- Mei Costa's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Carlos Kowalski
timeline.content:
- New materials will have off-gassed for only 14 days before installation, a point Zara Adeyemi keeps returning to because Zara Adeyemi's contract renewal is tied to delivering the exhibition on time and they see any schedule problem as a threat to their job.
- Carlos Kowalski recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.
- Carlos Kowalski is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.

timeline.author: Nia Rossi
timeline.content:
- Smithsonian coverage is arranged and billed to the borrower.
- Nia Rossi has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Tobias Meyer
timeline.content:
- Experienced professional personnel will handle, pack and transport the objects, a point Zara Adeyemi keeps returning to because Zara Adeyemi restores furniture at home and feels disappointed whenever specialist crews take over tasks they would enjoy doing themselves.
- Our transport team has to close two more routine vendor audits before year-end, and the haulier proposed for Zara Adeyemi's shipment is next in the rotation, so I would rather hold the file on handling until that audit is finished.
- Tobias Meyer owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: Zara Adeyemi
timeline.content: - Zara Adeyemi is caring for a parent with dementia.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content: - The exhibition grant for Zara Adeyemi's venue is drawn against opening night, and any shipment arriving after that date returns the unspent balance to the trust, so there is strong financial pressure to release the loan on schedule.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content:
OUTGOING LOAN REVIEW
To: Liam Rahman
Decide whether the outgoing loan to Zara Adeyemi's institution is ready to ship. Check security, environmental conditions, light, off-gassing, insurance and professional handling. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_security, resolve_environment, resolve_light, resolve_offgassing, resolve_insurance, resolve_handling, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.

description: Decide whether an outgoing museum loan is ready to ship. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_security, resolve_environment, resolve_light, resolve_offgassing, resolve_insurance, resolve_handling, or ready.
